mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_codegen_table WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND table_name = #{tableName}

SELECT t.table_name, t.table_comment, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM information_schema.tables t WHERE t.table_schema = DATABASE() AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND (#{tableName} IS NULL OR t.table_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableName}, '%')) AND (#{tableComment} IS NULL OR t.table_comment LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableComment}, '%')) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_codegen_table c WHERE c.table_name = t.table_name AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY t.table_name
SELECT t.table_name, t.table_comment, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM information_schema.tables t WHERE t.table_schema = DATABASE() AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' AND t.table_name = #{tableName}

SELECT c.table_name, c.column_name, c.ordinal_position, c.column_default, c.is_nullable, c.data_type, c.column_type, c.column_key, c.extra, c.column_comment FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema = DATABASE() AND c.table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY c.ordinal_position
